vcu_g_0159_20001c68.name: uid_words
vcu_g_0159_20001c68.description: Three 32-bit identity words copied at boot by vcu_uid_load from RAM mirrors 0x20002004, 0x20002008 and 0x2000200c (which hold the chip's 96-bit unique ID). app_verify_uid_checksum checks a stored record against their sum and product, and vcu_0159_080054ec passes the array to the frame builder. The values are not recorded here.

vcu_g_0159_20001cfa.name: display_blink_phase
vcu_g_0159_20001cfa.description: 0/1 phase flag. vcu_pa6_output_status_update toggles it and vcu_0159_080047ac clears it on state change; the display renderer uses bit 0 to alternate one LED group each tick (probably a blink phase). lighting_fade_step also reads it.

vcu_g_0159_20001d04.name: special_mode_display_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001d04.description: 0/1 flag set by vcu_special_mode_gate (1 on entry, 0 on exit). The display renderer tests it (below 1 selects the normal screen) so it can show the special-mode layout.

vcu_g_0159_20001d06.name: c14_c15_phase
vcu_g_0159_20001d06.description: Phase number of the C14/C15 sequence, values 1..3, set by vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer. The display renderer uses bits 0 and 1 to light the matching indicator segments (probably three phases).

vcu_g_0159_20001e68.name: input_status_e68
vcu_g_0159_20001e68.description: Status byte written by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch and read by most state handlers. Bit 6 (mask 0x40) is tested by the alarm edge trigger and the PA6 output as an alarm input (probably an external alarm line). Other bits are not decoded here.

vcu_g_0159_20001f40.name: rx_clock_word
vcu_g_0159_20001f40.description: Low 16-bit half of a clock word. vcu_rx_frame_dispatch writes it from received payload bytes 11..12, and vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick reads the full 32-bit word and takes the hour from bits 12..16 (snapshot in 0x20001884). Probably a packed time of day sent by the host (not confirmed). The upper half at 0x20001f42 is not a separate family in this packet and is not described here.

vcu_g_0159_20001f44.name: param_block_head
vcu_g_0159_20001f44.description: First byte of a 50-byte (0x32) block that vcu_0159_08009da8 zeroes at boot (bytes 0x20001f44..0x20001f75). Its address is passed to several state helpers (vcu_special_mode_gate, vcu_cycle_mode_on_request, vcu_countdown_start_handshake, vcu_toggle_special_mode, vcu_runtime_defaults_init), which suggests a parameter or state block. Only this first byte is described; the flags at 0x20001f48..0x20001f73 are separate globals.

vcu_g_0159_20001f48.name: link_active_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f48.description: Link-up flag. vcu_link_activity_heartbeat_tick sets it to 1 on peer activity (held for about 400 ticks) and clears it on timeout. vcu_link_keepalive_0x51_tick sends its keep-alive only while it is 1, and several timers (for example vcu_event_countdown_a and vcu_standby_entry_timer) test it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f4f.name: sensor_limit_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f4f.description: Limit flag set by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval: 1 when a scaled sensor word is over its limit (derate active), 0 when it recovers. The PA6 output, ready sequence, special-mode gate, standby logic and input handlers read it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f53.name: pa6_pending_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f53.description: Request flag set to 1 and cleared to 0 by vcu_input_edge_actions. vcu_pa6_output_status_update tests it together with the PA6 latch 0x20001340 before it toggles the output (probably a request-pending flag).

vcu_g_0159_20001f54.name: settings_commit_pending
vcu_g_0159_20001f54.description: Pending-commit flag: vcu_key_sequence_entry_tick sets it to 1 when a code is accepted, and vcu_pending_settings_commit clears it after the commit routine has run twice. The main state machine and vcu_0159_080054ec also test it (probably blocking other transitions while settings are written).

vcu_g_0159_20001f5c.name: timed_window_state
vcu_g_0159_20001f5c.description: State of the daily-window logic: vcu_0159_080054ec sets it to 0 or 1, the tick sets it to 1 or 2, and vcu_0159_08009da8 sets it to 3 at boot. Probably 0 idle, 1 request pending, 2 busy, 3 ready (not confirmed).

vcu_g_0159_20001f68.name: serial_match_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f68.description: 0/1 flag: vcu_serial_match_set_flag sets it to 1 when the stored serial equals the built-in default, and vcu_0159_080031f4 clears it. vcu_fault_warning_evaluate reads it to select one fault condition.

vcu_g_0159_20001f69.name: condition_a_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f69.description: Output of the up/down debounce vcu_debounce_condition_a (limit 20 ticks): 1 when the condition has been true long enough, 0 when it has been false. It drives alert 4 and the PA6 output; which physical input it follows is not determined.

vcu_g_0159_20001f6c.name: condition_a_prev
vcu_g_0159_20001f6c.description: Previous value of condition_a_flag (0x20001f69), kept by vcu_alarm_edge_trigger to detect the rising edge that raises alert 4.

vcu_g_0159_20001f70.name: standby_request_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f70.description: Standby request flag: vcu_input_edge_actions sets and clears it on input events; vcu_standby_entry_timer enters standby while it is set (the same as the 600-tick timeout) and clears it there.

vcu_g_0159_20001f71.name: special_mode_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f71.description: 0/1 request flag set and cleared by vcu_input_edge_actions. vcu_special_mode_gate tests it (1 is a request) and clears it when the request is taken.

vcu_g_0159_20001f73.name: c14_c15_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f73.description: 0/1 request flag set by vcu_input_edge_actions. vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer starts a pulse sequence when it is 1 and clears it.

vcu_g_0159_20001fa4.name: app_mode
vcu_g_0159_20001fa4.description: Application mode byte. vcu_0159_08009da8 loads it at boot from 0x20001b68 and sets it to 1 under a boot-time condition; vcu_toggle_special_mode switches it between its current value and the special value 4. The PA6 output tests it for 4 (special mode) and the ready sequence for 3.

vcu_g_0159_20001fa5.name: drive_table_row
vcu_g_0159_20001fa5.description: Row index of the drive-command tables in flash (row stride 0xA8, variant stride 0x18). vcu_serial_parse_variant_code sets it to 1, and vcu_drive_command_update reads speed and current limit entries at the row and variant offset (probably a speed-profile row; the default is 0).

vcu_g_0159_20001fa7.name: variant_index
vcu_g_0159_20001fa7.description: Variant index decoded by vcu_serial_parse_variant_code from the letter in the serial prefix (vcu_apply_variant_config switches on it with cases 0..5 and a default). It selects the option words (vcu_apply_variant_config), the mode limits (app_apply_mode_limits), the drive tables and parts of the PA6 and C14/C15 behaviour.

vcu_g_0159_20001fa8.name: sequence_done_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fa8.description: Completion flag. Several sequencers set it to 1 when their step or sequence ends (vcu_pb14_timed_edge_sequence, vcu_slot_193c_alert_tick, vcu_double_pulse_indicator_step, condition-B slot code), and the main state machine (vcu_0159_080047ac) clears it when it consumes the event.

vcu_g_0159_20001fb5.name: input_b_state
vcu_g_0159_20001fb5.description: State of input B (0/1), written by vcu_ninebot_rx_cmd_handle and read by the main state machine, the pair pulse pattern and the display. It is probably a debounced command or input line; the pulse pattern starts on its edge (see pair_pulse_last_input).

vcu_g_0159_20001fd4.name: event_countdown_b_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fd4.description: Flag set to 1 at expiry of event countdown B (vcu_event_countdown_b, reloaded on latch changes) and cleared when it is taken. The PA6 output, the main state machine, the timed window and the level gauge read it.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd5.name: ready_arm_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fd5.description: 0/1 flag of the ready/arm sequence (vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159): set to 1 when armed and cleared when disarmed. The special-mode gate and the standby logic test it (probably so they do not run while armed).

vcu_g_0159_20001fd7.name: pair_pulse_active
vcu_g_0159_20001fd7.description: 0/1 flag of the 60-tick two-output pulse pattern (vcu_pair_pulse_pattern_step): 1 while a pattern runs, cleared at its end.

vcu_g_0159_20001fe8.name: blink_request
vcu_g_0159_20001fe8.description: Blink request code. vcu_ninebot_rx_cmd_handle sets it to 10 (0x0a) for the C14/C15 blink command and to 11 (0x0b) for another command. vcu_c14_c15_blink_step runs its 40-tick blink cycle while it is 10, and the pulse logic tests it.

vcu_g_0159_20001fec.name: threshold_alarm_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fec.description: Flag set to 1 by vcu_threshold_alarm_latch while the threshold alarm is latched (DAT_20001e62 over its limit), and cleared when the value recovers. The PA6 output logic reads it.

vcu_g_0159_20002020.name: input_toggle_flag
vcu_g_0159_20002020.description: Toggle state flipped (xor 1) by vcu_input_edge_actions on each accepted press and cleared on reset (probably a two-state button toggle).

vcu_g_0159_20002022.name: c14_c15_request_a
vcu_g_0159_20002022.description: 0/1 request flag of the C14/C15 pulse sequence, set by vcu_input_edge_actions and by vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer and cleared by the sequencer and by vcu_aux_flags_reset. The pair pulse pattern and the alert tone sequencer also test it.

vcu_g_0159_20002023.name: c14_c15_request_b
vcu_g_0159_20002023.description: Second 0/1 request flag of the C14/C15 sequence, with the same users as c14_c15_request_a and its own clear in vcu_aux_flags_reset.

vcu_g_0159_20002024.name: c14_c15_state
vcu_g_0159_20002024.description: State of the C14/C15 sequence. 0 and 2 both allow a new start, and 1 means a sequence is running (probably). Set by the sequencer, the main state machine and vcu_input_edge_actions.

vcu_g_0159_20002025.name: c14_c15_toggle_a
vcu_g_0159_20002025.description: 0/1 toggle, flipped by vcu_input_edge_actions (xor 1) and cleared by the C14/C15 sequencer. A new sequence starts only when both toggles are 0 and the state is 1 (probably which output phase goes next).

vcu_g_0159_20002026.name: c14_c15_toggle_b
vcu_g_0159_20002026.description: Second 0/1 toggle of the C14/C15 sequence, with the same users as c14_c15_toggle_a (cleared by the sequencer and by vcu_input_edge_actions).

vcu_g_0159_20002027.name: c14_c15_busy_flag
vcu_g_0159_20002027.description: 0/1 flag set to 1 by vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer while a phase is active. A new phase starts only when this flag is 0 and the phase timer 0x20002028 is below 41 (probably).

vcu_g_0159_20002028.name: c14_c15_timer
vcu_g_0159_20002028.description: Tick counter of the C14/C15 sequencer. It is incremented while a phase runs, a new phase may start while it is 40 or less, and it is compared with 81 (0x51) after each increment. vcu_aux_flags_reset clears it.

vcu_g_0159_200021c4.name: level_threshold_state
vcu_g_0159_200021c4.description: State of the level-threshold logic, values 0..3. vcu_level_hold_timer_update sets it to 3 when the level has been high long enough, vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count sets it to 1, and the timed window and the threshold logic clear it. Probably a sensor threshold state (not confirmed).

vcu_g_0159_200021e4.name: flag_list_length
vcu_g_0159_200021e4.description: Number of entries in flag_list (0x200021e8). vcu_flag_bitmap_expand resets it to 0 and increments it for each set bit; the display renderer uses it as a loop bound against the cursor indices 0x200014fc and 0x20001500.

vcu_g_0159_200021e8.name: flag_list
vcu_g_0159_200021e8.description: List of up to 96 item indices (values 1..0x21, offset by 0x11 or 0x21 for flag groups). vcu_flag_bitmap_expand builds it from the set bits of the flag words 0x20001ce0..0x20001ce4, and the display renderer reads entries by index and clears the whole 96-byte list on refresh. The even-offset families 0x200021ea..0x200021f2 are elements of this list.

vcu_g_0159_200022c8.name: flag_word_prev
vcu_g_0159_200022c8.description: Previous copies of the three 16-bit flag words 0x20001ce0, 0x20001ce2 and 0x20001ce4 (element 0 = ce0). vcu_flag_bitmap_expand compares them with the live words to decide whether the flag list must be rebuilt, and the display renderer clears them to force a rebuild. A second shadow of the same words is flag_word_shadow at 0x2000148a.

vcu_g_0159_200022d6.name: flag_list_dirty
vcu_g_0159_200022d6.description: 0/1 flag set to 1 by vcu_flag_bitmap_expand when the flag list was rebuilt, and cleared by the display renderer after it has used the list. The renderer also tests it together with the flag words 0x20001ce0 and 0x20001ce2.

vcu_g_0159_2000329e.name: adc_avg_result_1_4
vcu_g_0159_2000329e.description: Elements 1..4 of the five 16-bit ADC channel averages at 0x2000329e, 0x200032a0, 0x200032a2 and 0x200032a4. vcu_adc_average_16_scans writes all five (sum of 16 scans >> 4, raw 12-bit range), and each element has its own getter (app_get_u16_2000329e, _200032a0, _200032a2, _200032a4). Element 0 at 0x2000329c is adc_avg_result_0 in data_adc_batch01.
